name: The soul-drinking sword
description: A sword Dakkon forged for Dihada over ten years, quenched in the blood of his slaves, into which Dakkon's shadow and soul were absorbed.

timeline.summary: Dakkon works for ten years forging the sword, quenching it in the blood of his slaves.
timeline.quote: for ten years he worked tirelessly, quenching the sword again and again in the blood of his slaves.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns to claim the finished sword and keeps her word, igniting Dakkon's Spark.
timeline.quote: She kept her word, igniting Dakkon’s Spark and unlocking his power as a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Dihada betrays Dakkon by absorbing his shadow and soul into the blade.
timeline.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

relations.quote: for ten years he worked tirelessly, quenching the sword again and again in the blood of his slaves.
